svg.title: Pericentric inversion: crossover and anaphase I
svg.desc: Stage A repeats the source four-chromatid inversion loop. Stage B shows two unchanged chromatids and the two reciprocal recombinant products, with source allele order, ancestry colors and centromeres retained. Both recombinant chromatids are monocentric, with reciprocal a/d duplication and deficiency.
svg.metadata: Original editable schematic, created 2026-11-10. Source facts: genetics/LECT13/djot/assets/lect13b-chromo_alter_3-inversion/image_012.png; original ODP slides 6, 10, 12, 14, 16. Geometry newly composed, not traced. Unmeasured. Source labels and stage/copy counts preserved.

g.text: When the centromere is included in the inversion loop, one of the crossover products
is duplicated for a and deficient for d; the other is duplicated for d and deficient for a.
Among the two chromatids not involved in the crossover, one carries the inversion
